metadata.scenario: A caller urgently needs locksmith services as they are locked out of their home in the middle of the night. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Susan Garcia. I'm really worried—I need help urgently. I'm here to help, Susan. Can you tell me what's going on? I was referred by my father's pulmonologist. He's really struggling with his COPD, and I need respiratory care and breathing treatments immediately. I understand how urgent that sounds. Can you provide me with your father’s details? His name is Robert Garcia, and he's 76. He was just discharged from the hospital, and we need immediate assistance at home. I see. We can send a skilled nurse to help with his respiratory care. How soon can they be there? I’m really worried about him right now. We can schedule a visit as soon as possible. Would you prefer a morning slot? Yes, please. The sooner, the better! Let me check our availability... We can send a nurse by 9 AM. Does that work for you? Yes, that works! But can you also guide me on what care he needs? Absolutely. We provide skilled nursing care focused on medication management and breathing treatments. How much will that cost? Our skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 for a visit. Okay, I can manage that. What do I need to do next? I’ll set up the appointment, and you'll receive a confirmation call shortly. Can I get your phone number? Yes, it’s +13165553749. Great! I’ll also send over a care plan for your review. Thank you! Is there anything else I need to do? Just be ready for the nurse, and ensure your father has his medications ready. Will do. This is such a relief. I’m glad to hear that, Susan. We’ll make sure he gets the care he needs. Thank you so much for your help. You’re welcome! Have a good night. Good night.
